_comment: Edit the expID lists and run knobs here, then pass this file with --config.

_field_help.movie_expids: List every movie experiment to analyze. Put one expID per line/item in the YYYY-MM-DD_NN_ANIMAL format.
_field_help.sleep_expids: List every sleep experiment to analyze. These are processed with sleep_state.pickle only, and the anatomical compartment is inherited from the same-day source when available.
_field_help.result_root: Directory where the soma/bouton outputs will be written. Each comparison preset gets its own subfolder under this root.
_field_help.cache_root: Directory where the soma/bouton cache files will be written.
_field_help.soma_channel: Suite2p channel index used for soma traces. Use 1 unless your soma data were saved on another channel.
_field_help.bouton_channel: Suite2p channel index used for bouton traces. Use 0 unless your bouton data were saved on another channel.
_field_help.lag_window_s: Window size in seconds for the lag scan around zero lag.
_field_help.lag_step_s: Step size in seconds for the lag scan.
_field_help.shuffle_n: Number of shuffle iterations used for the comparison statistics and null distributions. Increase for more stable p-values.
_field_help.state_comparison_states: Explicit state labels for the main pairwise comparison stack. If you set this, it is used directly instead of deriving states from broader mode presets.
_field_help.compartment_states: Explicit state labels for the parallel compartment comparison stack. For soma/bouton this should usually match state_comparison_states so the preset behavior stays consistent.
_field_help.event_detection_method: How calcium events are detected before event-rate summaries are written. Use derivative for the current default derivative-based detector or amplitude for the legacy amplitude-based detector.
_field_help.visual_response_metric: Which metric the shared response-summary path should use. Use mean for the original mean-trace path or calcium_events to classify from event frequency instead.
_field_help.rebuild: Set true to ignore any existing cache and rebuild everything from the raw files.
_field_help.plots_only: Set true to reuse the saved CSV outputs and only regenerate plots, without recomputing row-level results.
_field_help.comparison_presets: Named comparison presets executed one at a time by the runner. Each preset can override the top-level comparison knobs, and --comparison-presets can select a subset by name.
_field_help.comparison_preset_name: Set automatically when a preset is running. Usually leave this null in the base config.
_field_help.comparison_preset_names: Optional subset of preset names to run from the comparison_presets block.
_field_help.visual_response_cohort: Which visual-response cohort to emphasize in downstream reporting. Use all to keep responsive and nonresponsive units together, or responsive/nonresponsive to focus on one split later.
_field_help.visual_response_trial_types: Trial labels treated as visually stimulated when classifying responses from cut_intertrials data.
_field_help.visual_response_blank_trial_type: Trial label treated as the blank/reference condition when classifying visual responses.
_field_help.cache_path: Source cache file used to reload the raw per-experiment rows for soma/bouton reruns.
_field_help.analysis_results_cache_path: Cache file used to reload the final soma/bouton analysis manifest and summary tables.
_field_help.analysis_tables_cache_path: Intermediate cache file for the derived soma/bouton analysis tables.
_field_help.analysis_run_cache_path: Optional shared run cache path used for future layered cache reuse.
_field_help.analysis_results_rebuild: Force rebuilding the final analysis-results cache even if it already exists.
_field_help.analysis_tables_rebuild: Force rebuilding the derived analysis-tables cache even if it already exists.
_field_help.source_cache_rebuild: Force rebuilding the raw source cache even if it already exists.
_field_help.shared_shuffle_cache_rebuild: Force rebuilding the shared shuffle cache used by the statistical tests.
_field_help.mixed_model_contrast_p_source: Choose whether mixed-model contrasts report classical or shuffle-based p-values.
